title: file hint and datetime fieldset
rule: File: `hintText` states max size / types / count; `dragAreaText` names drag-and-drop; `addedFileAriaText` is read before the filename; `removeFileText` names remove. Dual-cite USWDS prefer-one-file. Datetime combo: wrap date+time in a fieldset with a legend; desktop uses external HintText/StatusText ids on `aria-describedby`; mobile uses built-in hint/status because fields stack.
pass_when: File hints name size/types/count; drag and remove strings are named; added-file SR text precedes the filename. Date+time share a fieldset/legend; desktop external hint/status ids; mobile built-in hint/status on stacked fields.
fail_when: File input has no size/types/count hint; date+time are unrelated fields with no shared legend; desktop omits external describedby ids while claiming this pattern.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: USWDS prefer-one-file / file types+size as a merge that drops the named string props; date-hint `PP.KK.VVVV` as this fieldset row.
